sentences.text:
This application under section 438 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime
No.99 of 2016, under sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 376, 511 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S.
Lalkurti, District Meerut.
2.  At the outset, Sri J.B. Singh, counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of this application with liberty to the applicant to surrender before the concerned court and apply for regular bail.
3. In view of the above, the instant application is dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty.
